title: The gutter, filled
logline: A page that is only the space between two tiers — the gutter — filled: the alley's gravel drawn in the strip's white, edge to edge. The book prints it small. The point is that there is no such place.

panels.composition: A narrow horizontal band of drawn gravel, the width of a comic's gutter, filling a page otherwise blank above and below.

image.prompt: a single full comic page with no panel borders, spare knowing ink line with economy, muted ochre and slate blue and sea-foam green washes, a narrow horizontal band of drawn alley gravel the width of a comic gutter filling an otherwise blank page, nothing above or below, no words

art.line: spare, knowing; economy of line; Era I's black spotting back on purpose in the mill run
art.palette: muted ochres, slate blues, misty sea-foam greens; luminous sunbreaks in the last spring
art.paper: Arches; bristol; the backs of motel registration cards
